long_biography.plain_text:
Subramanya Construction and Development Company was established in Bengaluru in 1992 and promoted by Nagesh Balasubramanyam's father, K. N. Balasubramanyam. Nagesh became a director before advancing to managing director. The business grew around commercial buildings, technology parks, land development and leasing. Subramanya Arcade became a principal office asset in its operating portfolio.

Nagesh has also represented the group in partnerships outside conventional property development. In 2010 he appeared for SCDC when it agreed a joint venture with CAPA for an aviation education and training campus in India. He later participated in the programme's executive-education launch. He has also held directorships in infrastructure, energy, hospitality and investment companies.
